threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You’re still trying to figure out which bus to take instead of just hopping on the Overground. Everyone else knows the shortcuts.
Caught a guy on the 12 bus last night arguing with a lamppost about existentialism. Only in Peckham, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I found an open-air yoga class in Hasenheide while a street musician played jazz nearby. Pure Neukölln magic.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can buy fresh falafel from a street vendor at 3 AM in Kreuzberg, surrounded by pre-party chatter. It's a uniquely Berlin experience.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they side-eye the guy selling churros on Valencia during a heatwave, like, 'not today, buddy.'

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading the Muni crowd with a ukulele at Civic Center while we waited for the bus. Classic San Francisco moment, right there.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think our plazas are just for Instagram, but locals use them for quiet moments with a café con leche, often after work.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by the way they struggle with the metro ticket machines—staring at the buttons like it’s a Rubik’s Cube.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still flinch when the buskers start a 10-minute loop of the same song. Welcome to Dalston, where the remix is life.
Caught the 35 last night, a guy was arguing with a lamppost. Telling it to ‘stop glowing so bright’. Brixton after midnight never disappoints.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of kids using a bike as a makeshift skateboard ramp on the sidewalk, laughing as they sprawled onto the grass. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find a club that opens at 6 AM and serves breakfast while the night crowd spills out into the daylight.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot the locals by how they navigate around the BART delays; tourists just stand confused, while we take the side streets like pros.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a pigeon riding the Muni at 6th and Market this morning. It strutted down the aisle like it owned the place, and nobody even blinked.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all the plazas in Gràcia are just for sipping drinks, but most locals use them as shortcuts to avoid the traffic.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still look at the metro map like it's a treasure map, trying to decipher every stop with wonder.
